//: Install once: npm i -g firebase-tools && firebase login && firebase use attendence-app-f7f9d

hosting.//: The web build of the same React Native codebase. `npm run build:web` writes dist/ via expo export.

rewrites.//: app.json sets web.output to 'single', so this is a client-routed SPA — every path has to fall through to index.html or a refresh on /login 404s.

headers.//: Hashed filenames, so they can be cached indefinitely.
The shell must never be cached, or a deploy ships new assets to a browser still holding the old index.
